subject: CONTROL clause
notes: The operands are captured in written order into ReportModel.Controls and emitted in that order as AddControl calls, so index 0 is the major control and the last is the minor. The golden proves the ordering behaviourally: its first operand CX(1:3) is the level whose footing prints last at a break and whose SUM covers both minor groups, while its second operand CX(4:) breaks on its own.
